row: W2-R5 The 'not in my notes' line - measured before the device run
how: Ran the line's own two inputs through the real code on the device: whether a note reached the model this turn, and whether the library covers the running game. Then asked kb_not_in_notes_notice.should_show_not_in_notes_notice whether it would print.
what_the_row_expects: The line on the first question (bone hydra, Strategy, Hades running) and on nothing else.

which: Heat and the Pact of Punishment

hydra_speed.why: Speed is never eligible for the line, by design

which: Heat and the Pact of Punishment

questions_tried.q: what are the best snowboarding tricks
how do i tame a horse
where do i buy a house
how do i change the difficulty of the golf course

how_hard_is_it_to_attach_nothing.result: Ten Strategy questions on a covered game, including pure gibberish. Every single one attached at least one note. The line printed on none of them.

verdict: FAIL, predicted before the device run and to be confirmed on it. The line shipped in wave two cannot appear for a game the library covers, because the note search always finds something to attach. The same root cause as the tip problem wave three is fixing: nothing in the search can say 'none of these fit'.
